content.short: ContractReader lets you read and understand smart contracts.
content.description: On Etherscan, contracts are simply static grey slabs of code. ContractReader transforms each smart contract into a living, interactive, three-dimensional document that you can explore from top to bottom: read the code, interact with the contract right next to the code that is executed, and view live on-chain values as they update in real time. The interface integrates code with its runtime data, clearly providing a GPT-4 security review for any contract at the click of a button.
content.meta: ContractReader turns static smart contracts into a live, interactive document. Discover ContractReader and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Jumping From Etherscan To The Source
resources.tldr: The extension that adds a button on Etherscan, OpenSea and Blur pages to open that token's contract in a readable view.

resources.title: What the Tool Is Good For
resources.tldr: Aimed at auditors, bounty hunters and anyone reading someone else's contract before interacting with it.
